title: Analysis code for The Friday NO₂ decline across Algerian cities in weather-normalised TROPOMI observations: Replication and limits of short-event attribution
description: Portable publication code and staged analysis plans for the Algerian TROPOMI NO2 study. The release preserves the original statistical models; portability changes and new export/validation tools are documented. Input data are distributed separately. No public DOI or repository URL is claimed before deposit.
